To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a hybrid plasma torch can be operated in a wide range of plasma characteristics and that the application of inert gas shrouds can significantly improve the coating quality.

The plasma characteristics and thus the in flight behavior of the particles can be controlled by changing the torch operational parameters and inert gas shrouded plasma spraying can reduce the in flight oxidation and improve the coating properties.
the hybrid plasma torch is a flexible and promising tool for plasma spraying of metallic powders.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new type of plasma torch for plasma spraying of metals and alloys.
the optimization of hybrid plasma torches for spraying of reactive metals and the development of new spraying techniques.
the optimization of the hybrid plasma torch operation and its application to the plasma spraying process of refractory metals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the application of shrouded spraying can be recommended for the spraying of copper, but not for tungsten, which is a more reactive material.
, for a given torch, the spraying conditions can be optimized to achieve a high degree of control over the plasma and particle parameters and thus the coating properties.
the hybrid torch offers a high flexibility for the control of the plasma and thus the particle properties and the coatings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hybrid plasma torch can be used for spraying of metallic materials, and inert shrouding can be applied to reduce in flight oxidation and to improve coating properties.

the hybrid torch is an interesting alternative for the conventional plasma torches, offering the possibility to spray a wide range of metallic materials, with a good control of the plasma characteristics.
, for spraying of tungsten, the use of shrouding is beneficial, while for copper the effect is not significant.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the hybrid torch is a flexible tool for the spraying of metallic powders, which can be optimized for a specific application.
hybrid torches offer a wide range of possibilities to optimize the spraying process for specific requirements.
the hybrid torch can produce coatings with properties that can be tailored for specific applications.
